steps.text: 4:12 P.M. \ Cloudy, Kazimierz Fireblade Arena
Independent knight Maria Nearl vs. 'Left-hand' Tytus Topola, one hour and twenty minutes in

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Right now, this arena... is host to a once-in-a-lifetime event!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: She gets knocked down, and she gets up, again and again! That spark of light still hasn't left the eyes of the audience! It's as if it's taken root in the smeared blood and soil of the arena!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: That one spark of light—! Just like a candle lit in the night! Under the ever more oppressive onslaught of Tytus, a man who lives to crush the will of his opponents—

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: —It's still alive!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Haahh... haaahh...

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: You... stand once again. You...

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: I see. The most miniscule Arts to heal your wounds, never running out, all the while looking for weaknesses—

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: —Does it feel good? Enduring your flesh on the verge of collapse for so long?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Hah... hah... no, I'm fine...

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Stubborn.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Nothing more than a parlor trick.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: She—she blocks! It's the first time she's done it! Maria has blocked Tytus's attack!

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: What... did my blade glance...?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: No, it was dead on... but you're hitting—a lot less hard.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: You... you have to get tired too, Tytus...

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: I do?

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Certainly... I have wasted far too much time on you.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Let me end this.

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: He hit again—!

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: The flow's completely changed... Who knows what'll happen now...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Gugh...

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Hmph. I know all your little tricks now. No reason to cede you a single chance more.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (Too fast—)

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: He! Gives! No! Quarter!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: A relentless rush! Not letting Nascent Nearl catch her breath! Will this finally put out that last spark of light?!

steps.name: Tourist A
steps.text: Can that girl... even hold on anymore? This match's boring now, I'm done...

steps.name: Tourist B
steps.text: ...That one's Maria Nearl, right...? Margaret's little sister?

steps.name: Tourist A
steps.text: Really? I've been coming to the Majors for two years now, and she's nowhere on the same level.

steps.name: Tourist B
steps.text: But when they flip the script, that's what's worth seeing, isn't it?

steps.name: Tourist A
steps.text: I mean...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria! Stand up straight!
Vision's blurry.
Don't blink, Maria.
Blink, and they'll never open again.
Maria, you are gifted with a pair of pegasian eyes.
Maria. Stand. Come, come forth.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Grandpa...
Cry not, my child.
What is the motto of the Nearl family?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: 'Fear neither hardship nor darkness...'
I do not regret the past. It brings me so much joy that Margaret chose to walk a different path.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret...?
In confronting all hardship, all darkness, generation after generation, each of our us have made our own choices.
Margaret chose the path least realistic.
Has she... has your sister ever spoken to you of her vision of a knight?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: 'To be a knight is to be the noble light that illuminates the land...'
Heh, heh. At such a young age...
Wishing only to be light.
Wishing only to dispel the hardship and darkness.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: ...One second later, and you may have been freed from this meaningless battle. Why stand up?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Uncle Młynar... was wrong.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: It wasn't at all... It was only a sigh...
Deep breaths. Deep breaths, Maria.
Keep exerting yourself and you won't win. Use his arrogance. Use his overconfidence.
What would Margaret do?
Just one opening... just one opening.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Mph—

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: And suddenly, a burst of light! What in the world just happened?! Are we gonna have to give out free sunglasses next time—?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: This is the first time the Left-hand Knight Tytus has backed off! There's Arts! No doubt about it, this is Maria Nearl's own Arts! Is she using Arts to turn the tables at the last minute?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Ooooh! There's been a small tremor in Maria's figures! But even still, the odds are just astounding! The numbers are rivalling corporate donations, now! Would you look at this prize pool?!

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: The Radiant Knight...

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: ...No, only a pale shadow of an imitation.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: You... you will pay dearly for this act of contempt.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria—!

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: You can do it! Go, Nearl!

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: Hey! Maria Nearl! You can do it!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria! Stay focused—! Beat him into the ground!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The cheers! Everyone out there is cheering for Maria, now!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: But even then—! Tytus still has free rein to walk the arena!

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (Blocked it!)

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: And the tale keeps twisting! They're both spent, but she's actually made a massive comeback!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Ladies! And! Gentlemen! Keep your eyes right on the prize, whether it's the marvelous match or the extravagant prize pool! It's all shaped up to be the most worthwhile event of the season yet!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Let's see more coin and more screams! Gotta let your knights know just how hyped you are!

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: You—you have the nerve to block my attacks! Leaning on your puny smattering of Arts?!

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Arrogant. I hate the arrogant. I loathe them.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: It is readily apparent that Tytus could have won this. His vision tunneled on trampling the Nearls' dignity. This middling, neglectful means of combat always tends to offer the other side an advantage.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: I-I see...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: After all, she is the Radiant Knight's sister, and the granddaughter of a certain 'Nearl.' Hah. My past self could've only pictured that fear-inspiring old lout upon hearing the name 'Nearl.'

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Such is the decline of the knightly family, it would make one weep. Compared to the corporate, a knightly family's dreary class conflicts truly are so fragile.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: The Association controls the entire noble class, now...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: And so we control the Knights Association.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: We just... received word from a lot of our sponsors... They want the Left-hand Knight to end the battle ASAP...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: They're worried that Tytus will lose. But there is no harm in him losing. The sticking point is how hot that topic is, and on that, I am very much satisfied.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: You, um, think so?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Mm... he is the commander of the Blade Helmet Knightclub. Arrogant, believes the universe revolves around himself. But he is undeniably strong, and sublime in the art of torturing his enemy's will to fight.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: In all previous competitions, he relished his opponents kneeling in surrender. And so...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: He is sure to lose.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Haahh... haaahh...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (No, need to be steady... can't stand upright... just, stay like this... and breathe...)

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Enough!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria—!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: (Maria... should've long since reached her limit... Even in her duel with Ingra, she never got hit this bad...)

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: —You've shed your blood for this! Grit your teeth, Maria!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Win!

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Humiliating... I've wasted my time humoring nothing but trash...

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Will you beg for my mercy only once I have crippled you?

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: You're just like 'Whislash' was—prepare yourself!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Now—!
I'm still trying to learn from Margaret. The way she used Arts. That turn of her wrists.
But—

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: You... block me again?!

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: You utter—

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: N-Now that's no coincidence! Maria's once again blocked the Left-hand Knight's onslaught! What's going on?! Could Tytus be toying with the already cornered Nearl!?

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: ...Good. Very good. I don't know what you're thinking... but no matter. I will crush every speck of your light to dust.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Come.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Look closely, y'all! This is the first time the Left-hand Knight's ever taken that stance! The first time he's ever let his opponent pull one over on him!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Even against Nascent Nearl, don'tcha think this is a little extreme?! No! Anyone who knows Tytus knows it's not! All his fans here in the arena know the score!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: But he's really hit his head against it today! Maria's resolve hasn't wavered one bit! I've gotta admit, folks, the way she's hanging in there, even I'm shedding a couple tears!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Listen up! Everyone who supports Maria Nearl gets an entry in a post-match lottery! Your chance to win is a lofty 0.2%! Who wants to be the lucky one?!
—Something isn't right.
Fatigued, timid, the fear of humiliation overcoming her, pushed to the edge as she is—
In her heart lies only victory. She wills to win. She's conjured countless ways to grasp this one last chance firm.
But in this instant, she can only question that victory she's been pursuing all this time.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: ...Maria Nearl, for what reason did you join the Major? Glory? Wealth? Or was it your family?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: For... myself.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Nothing more... Mr. Tytus.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: ...Hmph.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: An instant's feint. Arts focused on your shield. You really do... have the blood of a pegasus... tch.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: You fought a radiant fight, Nearl...

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: We've just had—the lengthiest duel of this entire season—! And the one who fell was none other than 'Left-hand' Tytus Topola!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Who could've seen this coming—! I ask you! Who could've seen this coming?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Completely unreal odds and titanic prize money—hey, show us those numbers, now—this is enough to start your own little business!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: A miracle—! No doubt about it, this is a miracle! Maria Nearl! The Nearl family has brought us a miracle once again!
The audience all wait.
They wait for Maria to raise the scratch-ridden sword in her grip, and declare victory.
An upset to talk about. Astronomical wagers. A soul-stirring, heartrending comeback.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (What now?)
Is this the Major? What is it you won? What did you get from all this?
Glory, wealth, your family's honor, but what is it you're missing...? Hm, what is it you're missing?
And without much time to think about it, as if in pure response to the cheering all around her, Maria holds her sword up high.
Only the pain, sharp, radiating from her hand, overcomes the applause.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Hfff...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (I can't... I can't stand—)

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: A... Auntie?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria... Maria...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: A-Auntie Zofia... let go, let go, it hurts...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Oh, sorry... did you break a bone??

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Mm-hm... but it's no big deal...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria... I'm sorry... I might've been too harsh on you before.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You're just like your sister. You're a knight, and you should be able to choose your own path—

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria...?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I might... really be nothing like my sister.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: ...Maria won. That match'll have been broadcast on every terminal in the four cities.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: But... it's not that simple. You gotta help her, Młynar.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Truly a miracle. If you're so worried for Maria, why ask me to help her, and her to give up on her idiotic path to knighthood?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Młynar!

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: That's enough... If the spokesmen and the Knights Association are to directly intervene, I won't have a single hand to lend...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: This is precisely why I was opposed to Maria becoming a competition knight in the first place.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Maria decided to do this for her family, y'know.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Nobody ever asked her to... Don't give me those self-righteous excuses.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: There are times when responsibility makes a burden. For the sake of a life lived clearer, we should all be a little smarter.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Młynar, you...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: —If this is all you came to tell me, you can go now. I have other things to deal with. I'm still not done yet with some files the Director wanted...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: ...I thought you were down in a slump, Młynar.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Don't be presumptuous, Marcin.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Yeah. Maybe you're right. You've really disappointed us all, Młynar.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: And the same for all of you.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: If you can't even bring yourself to care for Maria's safety... then we'll look after old Nearl's granddaughter for him.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You're leading her to ruin and you know it clear as day.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Wasted my breath... go on, pretend I never came, then.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...Any trouble those two sisters make should be theirs to sort out.

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: ...How long do we have to keep hiding, Sona?

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Don't rush it, jeez...

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: We can't stop... we don't want any of our Infected here to starve. And we already lost one we could've saved.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Heading back to the arena's too risky, though. Dunno how the National Council feels about us, either...

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: National schmational... I don't there's any justice in Kazimierz anymore. Not even in the law.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: But we can't let ourselves forget we're all in the right. It's not our fault if they say right's wrong. The problem is if the National Council comes in to say we're guilty, then we lose. Just like the Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: But, hey... haha, their minds must be blown. Honestly, I did NOT expect it either... What do you think they'll do next?

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Think they'll be watching all the Infected now? The ones we bought and freed...

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: ...It's all been one game. Die to the arena, or die to some assassin's arrow. No difference.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Hahaha. You got that right.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: But let's just hold out a biiiit longer. No reason to get Nearlie and all her people wrapped up in our stupid underground fight.

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: ...Alright. I'm gonna trust that you have a plan.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Who the hell knows? We've been doing this dumbass tightrope act since the beginning.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Aren't you scared, Ashley?

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: Sona!

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: We're not the sort of people to run into some resistance and think twice about it. Remember all we did just to get some titles... and the blood we spilled for them.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: ...You're right, you're right. I'm thinking too hard.

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: Yeah, you are... long as we're together, long as we've got a pair of fists to fight back with, we're golden.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Man, you're getting better and better at talking all the time. Where'd that 'Ashen Curse' go again?

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Oop. You mad now?
